title: Create → push → export, 30 d

args.command: call --json execute-sql {"query": "SELECT uniqIf(person_id, event = 'agentic_project_created') AS created, uniqIf(person_id, event = 'agentic_code_pushed') AS pushed, uniqIf(person_id, event = 'agentic_export_finished') AS exported FROM events WHERE event IN ('agentic_project_created', 'agentic_code_pushed', 'agentic_export_finished') AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY"}

jq: .results | split("\n") | {x: (.[0] | split("|")), series: [{name: "users", values: (.[1] | split("|") | map(tonumber))}]}
